proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: vertex-algebra-jet-relations.lean:98: "theorem euler_level_stable (n : ℕ) : (2 : ℤ) - 2 * 4 = -6 := by norm_num"
proof-narrative-lean-equiv.notes: The block's lean.ref is euler_level_stable, which proves only the numeric identity 2−2·4=−6 — neither the 34-relation proposition nor even the claimed level-stability (χ(A_n)=χ(A_0), tr_M of the identity). The Lean captures only JC-3's number, not the statement.

proof-statement-integrity.notes: The referenced theorem's conclusion is a constant arithmetic tautology, strictly weaker than (and disconnected from) the proposition it is the lean.ref for.

proof-no-self-assuming-projection.notes: euler_level_stable is not a projection of a structure field; descent_idempotent uses the genuine descent_left_inv field but derives idempotence rather than projecting the conclusion.

proof-no-trivial-true.notes: The lean.ref target is a closed numeric tautology discharged by norm_num, ignoring its ℕ argument; it asserts no proposition-level content (the χ value is hardcoded, not derived from any trace/level structure).

proof-no-false-premise.notes: No false/contradictory premise in the referenced declarations.

proof-no-unused-hypotheses.notes: The brane-level parameter n — the entire point of a 'level-stable' theorem — is bound but never used; the body proves a constant independent of n, so the level-stability content is not captured.

proof-no-decide-masking.notes: euler_level_stable uses norm_num (legitimate for the numeric goal), not decide/trivial masking a structural goal.

da-false-claim.notes: Stated relations are standard/plausible: J-1a Hecke σ²=(q−q⁻¹)σ+1 (repo §7a convention), J-2b antipode, χ=2−2·4=−6 (genus-4 Bring story); no counterexample found.

da-vacuous.notes: The block's named lean.ref is a vacuous numeric tautology; the substantive level-stability/Markov-trace content of JC-3 is absent from Lean (markov_level_compatible is an axiom restating a definitional equality).

da-circular.notes: No back-fitting; relations are structural lifts of the base-level QU/QUO presentation.

da-overclaim.evidence: vertex-algebra-jet-relations.md:470: "The total presentation on $J^n(A)$ comprises **34 relations**"
da-overclaim.notes: The proposition asserts a 34-relation presentation as holding at every level, but the Lean formalizes only a handful (hecke_level_independent, descent_idempotent) with two as axioms and the headline euler_level_stable as a tautology; the formalized support is much narrower than the catalog claims.

da-hidden-dof.notes: q is level-independent by Euler stability; no free parameter introduced across levels.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Catalog of relations with inheritance arguments; each is a standard lift, no unsupported 'therefore'.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: Lean proves a numeric tautology (and two axioms) far weaker than the 34-relation jet-prolongation proposition the lean.ref names.

da-citation-misuse.notes: kassel1995 (Hecke/Markov), jones1987 (link polynomials), yekutieli2010 (obstruction) are correctly attributed to the relations they back.

da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: Level operators ℓ_n, 𝔡_{n+1}, τ̂_n, tr_M^{(n)}, σ_i^{(n)} are introduced explicitly at the top of the block.

da-empirical-fragility.notes: χ=−6 is structural (genus-4), not a numerical fit.

da-physical-implausibility.notes: Bosonic/fermionic descent decomposition is an internal categorical statement; no units/conservation violation.
